chunks: He said: "O Aaron, what prevented you when you saw them going astray?"

key_terms.هَارُونُ: Aaron (peace be upon him), brother of Moses

ai.seo_question: What did Moses ask Aaron about the Golden Calf incident?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Taa-Haa, Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) questions his brother Aaron (peace be upon him) regarding the Golden Calf incident, specifically asking what prevented him from guiding the Israelites back to monotheism when he witnessed their deviation. Shia scholarship often highlights the nuance in Aaron's response, noting that while he was not at fault for the idolatry itself, he was questioned for not actively enforcing the people's return to God's path as much as he could have. This dialogue underscores the concept of *Amr bil Ma'ruf* (enjoining good) and the responsibility of leaders to correct communal errors.
